Eva: Quick q — when we forward-port a small fix from main to the stable release branch, do we create a new patch tag (e.g. v1.4.2) or keep the existing and append buildmeta? Trying to align releasebot behavior. cc @Priya @Sahil
Sahil: my take: if it's user-facing behaviour change -> patch. docs or nonfunctional infra changes -> buildmeta-only. Keeps semver meaningful. :thinking:
Marco: strongly: security fixes always bump patch. CVE trackers + support expect a new release number.
DeployBot: NOTICE: releasebot currently rejects tags that don't change semver when channel enforce-patch is true. See /release --help for flags.
Priya: customers pin exact versions; opaque buildmeta-only releases make tracing hard. prefer explicit patch bumps for anything that affects consumers. :eyes:
Taylor: counterpoint — infra churn (ci config, build tools) will flood release history if we bump for everything. can we gate patch bumps to only API/behavior/security?
Eva: proposal: ruleset — security & API changes -> patch; behavior-changing bugfixes -> patch; docs/config/CI -> buildmeta only. releasebot should auto-detect via labels.
Sahil: +1. Implementation idea: label mapping like "label:release/patch" and releasebot auto-bumps patch, else appends +meta.<shortsha>. Tests to assert semantics.
Marco: tag format suggestion: `vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH[-rcN][+meta]`. For forward-port cherry-picks add `+cherry.<shortsha>` so we can trace origin.
Priya: also require a release note entry for cherry-picks: "Cherry-picked from <sha>" — put in release notes before tagging.
Taylor: ops question — if someone accidentally tags a buildmeta-only change as a full patch, what's rollback flow? manual undo + redeploy?
DeployBot: ACTION: if a tag is pushed that violates protected rules, DeployBot will quarantine the tag and open a draft rollback PR to remove the tag within 30m. It will also post a webhook to #eng-oncall.
Eva: ok. I'll draft a short RFC + releasebot patch: detect labels, map -> bump or meta, and add `+cherry.<sha>` for forward ports. Anyone want to co-author? @Sahil @Priya
Sahil: I can implement the label->bump mapping and unit tests.
Priya: I'll author the release note template and examples for cherry-picks.
Eva: thanks all :thumbsup: I'll create the RFC in docs/release/process and ping the channel when it's up. Example releasebot usage I plan to document:
```
/release tag --mode patch --note "cherry-picked fix for user session refresh" --source cherry
```
End of thread.
